breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified that the detailed Strang splitting instructions were the intended method and omitted any mention of the conflicting 'Explicit forward Euler' method, thereby resolving the inconsistency.
